scenario: [LTIM.4.2.3]: `a - b` of two `Date`s is `0_s` when `a` is the earlier. One Span, `a` 2024-02-29 (day 19782) and `b` 2024-03-03 (day 19785). Rule `saturates` fires where `s.a - s.b == 0_s`; rule `negative`, where `s.a - s.b < 0_s`, would fire on the unsaturated -3 days and must not; rule `render` logs `(s.a - s.b)::String`, `0s`. PATH PINNED: FN_DATE_DIFF's saturation ([RLOW.6.1.6]: "`Date - Date` saturates inside `FN_DATE_DIFF`"), in libds (`rete/adapters.c`, `adapter_ds_date_diff`) and Mercury (`ds.eval.ltim_4_2_3_date_diff`).
rules_ds:
schema Span scope logical:
    id: Int key
    a: Date mutable
    b: Date mutable

rule saturates:
    Span s where s.a - s.b == 0_s
->
    log info "zero"

rule negative:
    Span s where s.a - s.b < 0_s
->
    log info "negative"

rule render:
    Span s
->
    let d = (s.a - s.b)::String
    log info "span {d}"
